content.comment_body: I am unable to remotely connect with my [product_name] [version_no] base module. Could someone provide a detailed procedure to help me accomplish this? Currently, I am using [product_name] V[version_no].

Could you clarify what you mean by 'remotely'? Are you trying to connect the [product_name] to another [product_name]? Or perhaps another PLC? Are you unable to access your [product_name] in the local network, or via the Internet? Please provide more details.
I can't access the [product_name] either on my local network or via the internet.
Could you please respond to my earlier questions?

I am able to reach the [product_name] through my local network, but I do not see any values or information displayed. Only the Base Module appears, and attempts to interact with the interface have no effect—the onscreen display remains blank.

Based on your description, it seems you are using the simple web server for [product_name] [version_no]. This web server shows a virtual display of the [product_name] but only displays programmed message texts if you enable the 'Web server' option when creating messages. The menu of the [product_name] cannot be shown on the simple web server. To perform actions using cursor keys, the ESC key must be activated in the virtual [product_name]. Refer to [url] for an instructional video related to programming the web server.
Apologies for the late reply. My question is: How do I activate the ESC key in the virtual [product_name] interface?

The virtual ESC key works as a latching button. Clicking it keeps it functionally pressed, allowing the use of cursor keys for actions defined in your program. Clicking the ESC key again will virtually release it.

analysis.insight_summary: The user initially faced difficulties with remote connectivity to a [product_name] [version_no], being unclear on the difference between local and remote access. Once network reachability was addressed, they encountered issues interacting with the web-based virtual display: although the device was visible, the display remained blank and controls were unresponsive. There was a lack of clarity on required configuration for web server features and virtual key handling. The user repeatedly sought guidance, evidencing a need for better documentation or in-app assistance regarding remote operation functions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants straightforward remote access that includes interactive control and real-time value display via the web interface. They expect concise, step-by-step instructions or an intuitive system that enables remote use of the virtual display and function keys.
